decisions.reason: The construction site dumper is only mentioned, not given its own page, which suggests weaker commitment, but it fits the firm's core vehicle competence and can share components with its other machines.
The inclined furniture lift has a dedicated page and serves a steady niche in moving and handling services, where lift lines are usually kept for many years and earn parts and service revenue.
The building material lift is well matched to the firm's construction and lifting customers and shares a platform with the furniture lift, so keeping it costs little.
The truck-mounted lift has a dedicated page and complements the lift range, although truck-mounted variants are more complex and face more competition.
